newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai to join new McDonnell project.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai to join new McDonnell project.

text.p: Hyundai Space and Aircraft Co, a unit of South Korea's Hyundai Group, will participate in McDonnell Douglas Corp's project to develop medium-sized planes, a Hyundai Space spokesman said on Friday.
The spokesman said Hyundai Group chairman Chung Mong-koo recently agreed in principle with McDonnell chairman John McDonnell to supply parts for 125-seater MD95-50 planes.
He said McDonnell was expected to officially launch the MD95-50 development project early next year.
The two companies have yet to officially sign a contract on the deal, the spokesman said, without giving further details.
In February, Hyundai Space agreed with McDonnell to supply wings for the 100-seater MD95-30 planes, with the first shipment due in the middle of 1998, the spokesman said.
